g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS multi-account network with Direct Connect, Transit Gateway and central inspection

g.title: None.None.Node.31
g.text: Flow: Office staff use the orders app
A member of staff opens the internal orders app
The data centre router sends it over the Direct Connect connection; the site-to-site VPN takes over if the link fails
A transit virtual interface carries it to the Direct Connect gateway
which is associated with the Transit Gateway in the network account
The Transit Gateway sends it through Network Firewall in the inspection VPC
then to the production VPC attachment
where the internal Application Load Balancer
sends it to the ECS Fargate orders service
Flow: Orders call the ERP system
The orders service posts each new order to the ERP system's REST API
Network Firewall inspects the call on its way out
The Transit Gateway reaches the data centre through the Direct Connect gateway, which advertises its prefixes
and the router delivers the call to the ERP system
A development instance sends internet-bound traffic to its Transit Gateway attachment
The spoke route table's default route points at the inspection VPC
Network Firewall allows only approved domains
The Transit Gateway sends inspected traffic to the egress VPC
where a NAT gateway translates it
and it leaves through the egress VPC's internet gateway
